description: Move source to destination — Moves objects from a source remote to a destination remote, optionally cleaning up empty directories.

_async.description: Run the command asynchronously. Returns a job id immediately.

_config.description: JSON encoded config overrides applied for this call only.

_filter.description: JSON encoded filter overrides applied for this call only.

_group.description: Assign the request to a custom stats group.

createEmptySrcDirs.description: Set to true to create empty source directories on the destination.

deleteEmptySrcDirs.description: Set to true to delete empty directories from the source after the move completes.

dstFs.description: Destination remote path that will receive moved files.

srcFs.description: Source remote path whose contents will be moved.

name: sync_move
